feature.title: Shape the outline in a chat, then build it lean
feature.problem: A course is researched, outlined, written, illustrated and reviewed in one go, so the first time you see its shape it is finished: if it starts in the middle or has chapters you don't want, the only fix is to rebuild, after spending 10M+ tokens. The builder is one AI orchestrator that re-reads its growing conversation at every step (76 input tokens per output token in the last build) and can decide to rewrite whole modules.
nonGoals: Editing a finished course (adding or removing chapters after writing) — a later feature.
Reordering by drag and drop; the chat and per-chapter remove cover the first version.
Changing the course file format beyond an optional one-line chapter summary.

states.loading: The build page shows Research and Outline as before; the outline panel appears when the outline is ready.

states.success: The outline updates in place after each change, the changed chapters marked; Write this course continues the build.
